title: Three fresh directions for Nature’s Harvest
summary: Explore three distinct website concepts for the independent Helensburgh fruit and veg shop. Open each preview to compare the layout, shopping journey and mobile experience.
notice: Design review only. Sample produce, prices and imagery are illustrative. Orders and payments are disabled in these public snapshots; the working WooCommerce build remains separate.

concepts.name: Market Day
concepts.description: Colourful, confident and full of the energy of a proper local market.

concepts.name: The Larder
concepts.description: Warm, traditional and a little more refined, with a focus on local quality.

concepts.name: The Fresh Edit
concepts.description: Contemporary, crisp and direct, with streamlined shopping at its heart.
